title: Nebraska AI Laws

reading.body:
Nebraska's only AI law is a conversational AI safety statute bundled with agricultural data privacy, passed April 17, 2026.

LB525 does two unrelated things in one act. The Conversational Artificial Intelligence Safety Act places disclosure, content prevention, privacy tool, and crisis protocol duties on operators of conversational AI services, with particular attention to minor account holders. The Agricultural Data Privacy Act gives producers ownership of data from their farm, land, devices, and equipment, bars its sale without express written consent, and requires reasonable security.

The pattern is that AI regulation in smaller states arrives attached to something else. Nebraska did not pass a standalone AI act. It moved conversational AI duties through a legislature by pairing them with a constituency that has real lobbying weight, agricultural producers. For AI specifically, the operative constraint is on operators of conversational services and how they treat minors, not on model training, data centers, or compute.

What this does not tell the reader is how the duties are enforced, what penalties attach, or whether the conversational AI provisions have taken effect. It also does not say how Nebraska's single law compares to other states, because only Nebraska's count is given here. One law is a thin basis for any claim about the state's posture.

Nebraska has enacted 1 AI-related law. Each is read from its enrolled text: what it does, who it applies to, when it takes effect, and what it requires.

Enacted AI laws in Nebraska

1 law this site judged relevant to AI, newest first, each read from its enrolled text.

  • LB525: Adopt the Agricultural Data Privacy Act and the Conversational Artificial Intelligence Safety Act passed 2026-04-17

    The law adopts the Agricultural Data Privacy Act, which gives agricultural producers ownership and control of agricultural data originating from their farm, land, devices, and equipment, and prohibits controllers and processors from selling that data without express written consent while requiring reasonable data security. It also adopts the Conversational Artificial Intelligence Safety Act, which imposes disclosure, content prevention, privacy tool, and crisis protocol duties on operators of conversational artificial intelligence services, especially for minor account holders. It amends the public records law to allow withholding agricultural data absent prior written consent from the owner.

How this page is kept

This page is generated from the enacted laws this site tracks for Nebraska. When the legislature passes another AI-related bill, it appears here the night the bill's text is read. The full 50-state picture is at State AI Laws.
